name: NY-26
label: Safe D

key_factors: Incumbent Tim Kennedy with $2.3M raised and $1.2M on hand
Challenger Dennis Hannon has no reported fundraising
model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to Kennedy: a D+11 district, incumbency, and a large financial edge against a challenger with no visible fundraising. Markets agree, pricing his win probability around 95%.
model.watch: Any late polling or surge in challenger fundraising showing the race tightening would be the first sign to revisit this rating.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Tim Kennedy, the Democratic incumbent in this Buffalo-area district, seeks re-election against Republican Dennis Hannon. The seat leans Democratic by about eleven points, and Kennedy enters with a substantial financial advantage, having raised over $2.3 million and holding $1.2 million on hand. No general-election polling is available, and no expert raters have flagged the race as competitive.

Prediction markets price Kennedy's chances near 95%, consistent with the district's fundamentals. With no evidence of challenger strength or outside spending against the incumbent, the race sits firmly in Safe D territory, though the absence of polling leaves some residual uncertainty.
